training_and_feature_selection: GSE151530 ONLY: input harmonized151530 counts/labels,18661genes. No GSE149614/189903/242889/202642 expression, genes or labels read for this training
source_annotation: Prior within-GSE151530 PGAM5-free myeloid clustering and conservative C1Q/CSF1R/CD68/TYROBP lineage rules; other author/inferred lineage labels retained. Annotation rules were previously reviewed across cohorts; this is not a newly blinded annotation study
target: Macrophage plus raw PGAM5 >0 (161/3493 cells). Undetected is RNA zero, not protein negative; positive cycling cells remain within target; cycling-undetected separate competitor
normalization: CP10k using original full-cell library count; duplicate symbols previously summed. No depth matching/covariates and no patient-paired DE
target_screen: Unpaired cell-level Wilcoxon with tie correction, BH over all18661genes; Scanpy approximate log2FC>=1,FDR<.05,detected_fraction>=.10. For target panel, donor-equal target mean must exceed max other active group mean (log2ratio+.05 >0). Max50 ranked positive class-contrast genes; defining PGAM5 additionally preserved and marked. No forced fill to50 and no claim that cell-level FDR establishes independent patient-level biology
competitor_screen: Fixed donor-equal CP10k references; each supported component top50 class-contrast genes, detection>=.10,mean>=.05,excludeMT-/RPL/RPS. Descriptive competitor features are not FDR-qualified target DE genes
group_support: Non-target classes require>=50cells,>=2donors; cycling competitors>=100cells, otherwise merge to parent orUnknown_other. Target training requires>=5positivecells across>=2donors for held-out feasibility; final target161cells. No missing pure lineage invented
reference: Gene union of target and competitors, rowRMS scale across simultaneous reference groups, nonnegative least squares. One fixed algorithm/panel setting; no TCGA outcome tuning
internal_diagnostic: Leave eligible donor out; redo target DE, features, donor-equal reference and scales without held-out donor. Known2000cell mixtures, target0/.005/.01/.02/.05,totalmac.25, tumor.5,remaininglineages.25,2repeats,cycling/monocyte/DC/pDC zero challenges. No external training or validation in this task
TCGA_application: User explicitly authorizes exploratory TCGA application despite prior validation failures. Gene list/reference locked before bulk matching; exact symbols only, unavailable genes omitted from both matrices. All371previously selected primary patients; no survival analysis added in this turn
interpretation: Relative reference-mixture coefficient normalized across all fitted components, not calibrated tissue cell abundance. Raw RNA label is not a proven biological subtype; QC does not correct ambient/doublet contamination.
